location: Elmont, Long Island, New York, USA

main_dirt.surface: Dirt (Modernized sandy loam cushion with engineered banking)
main_dirt.bias_notes: Counter-clockwise (left-handed). Completely reconstructed as part of NYRA's $455M Belmont Park redevelopment project. Reduced from the legacy 1.5-mile track to a modern 1 1/4-mile dirt oval with 1,097ft home straight. The new dirt surface provides improved consistency and drainage. Off-pace stalkers ('P') and strong-finishing swoopers ('S' and 'C' styles) have ample stretch length to run down early leaders in route races.
main_dirt.post_bias: FAIR BARRIER DISTRIBUTION: The 1 1/4-mile oval and sweeping 1,097ft home straight eliminate extreme barrier draw penalties. Over 6f, 7f, 1 Mile, 1 1/8M, and 1 1/4M distances, barrier draws are fair across all positions.

tapeta_synthetic.bias_notes: Counter-clockwise (left-handed). Brand new 1-mile Tapeta synthetic track constructed inside the main dirt track — NYRA's first all-weather synthetic surface. Handles winter racing and rainy off-turf transfers cleanly without surface deterioration. Favors horses with proven synthetic (Woodbine, Gulfstream Tapeta, Turfway, Presque Isle) or turf form.
tapeta_synthetic.post_bias: INSIDE TO MID DRAWS ADVANTAGEOUS: Draws 1 through 6 save ground into the first turn of 1-mile Tapeta route races.

outer_turf.surface: Turf (Cool-season grass mixture with sub-surface drainage)
outer_turf.bias_notes: Counter-clockwise (left-handed). Broad outer turf course with wide, sweeping turns. Extremely fair to all running styles.

inner_turf.bias_notes: Counter-clockwise (left-handed). Inner turf course featuring tighter turns. Elevates tactical speed ('P' style) and inside ground-saving trips.
inner_turf.post_bias: Inside barrier positions (1-5) hold a distinct advantage.

handicapping_angles.new_belmont_redevelopment_and_belmont_st: Home of the Belmont Stakes ($2M G1 - 1 1/4M, 3rd leg of the Triple Crown), Metropolitan Handicap ('Met Mile' $1M G1), Manhattan Stakes ($1M G1), Ogden Phipps (G1), Acorn (G1), and Frizette (G1). Class ratings represent elite Tier 1 international grade (+4.0 pts class angle).
handicapping_angles.tapeta_synthetic_all_weather_transition: The new 1-mile Tapeta synthetic track takes over off-turf races and winter meeting dates. Heavily upgrade horses with proven synthetic form (Woodbine, Gulfstream Tapeta, Turfway, Presque Isle, Fair Grounds) or high turf-to-synthetic pedigree ratings (+3.5 pts synthetic specialty angle).
handicapping_angles.chad_brown_pletcher_nyra_super_stables: Elite NYRA stables (Chad Brown, Todd Pletcher, Christophe Clement, Linda Rice, William Mott, Brad Cox) dominate New Belmont cards across dirt, turf, and Tapeta.
handicapping_angles.420m_stretch_swooper_capability: In 1 Mile, 1 1/8M, and 1 1/4M dirt routes, early leaders ('E' style) that set aggressive early fractions fold in the 1,097ft stretch. Favor mid-pack stalkers ('P') and closing swoopers ('S' / 'C') with proven late 300m sectional endurance.
handicapping_angles.typical_distances: Dirt: 6f, 6.5f, 7f, 1 Mile, 1 1/8M, 1 1/4M (Belmont Stakes). Tapeta: 5.5f, 6f, 1 Mile, 1 1/16M. Turf: 5.5f, 6f, 1 Mile, 1 1/8M, 1 1/4M, 1 1/2M.

par_adjustment.tier: Tier 1 (Elite NYRA Triple Crown Metro HQ)
